title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: Fixes Cmd+Click on parameter inlay hints to navigate to the correct parameter declaration.

highlights.title: Parameter Hint Navigation
highlights.description: Cmd+Click on a parameter name inlay hint now jumps directly to the parameter declaration instead of misfiring or producing no result.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Fixed Cmd+Click on parameter inlay hints — the action now navigates to the actual parameter declaration rather than resolving to the wrong symbol or doing nothing.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: This is a focused single-fix release. No other commands, settings, navigation behavior, or UI changed since v1.17.7.
